bearingAndGrip.bearing: All four cells retain elevated native front-right oblique head/chest/toe presentation. Fire projects toward screen-down-right; no row switches to rear or pure lateral bearing.
bearingAndGrip.grip: Ready has two separated upright grips; fire has plausible right shoulder/cheek stock, trigger-region hand and fore-end support; loading and raised rod have distinct upper action hand and lower steadying hand.
bearingAndGrip.limits: 2D hidden shoulder/stock, fingers, exact camera and historical drill remain uncertified; native barrel projection is oblique rather than a recovered canonical ballistic axis.

measurementContract.rootMeaning: Fresh manually estimated concealed pelvis-center X projected to a separately measured visible supporting boot sole Y in each native cell; a 2D registration pivot, not reconstructed anatomical pelvis or physical ground.
measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh visually chosen boot-only ROIs at alpha>=64; each exclusive bottom Y is measured separately. The selected foreground planted boot excludes rifle butt, opposite depth boot, and torso pixels. No row-shared ground or prior-source coordinates are inherited.
measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y in visually selected cap-only ROIs; excludes upright rifle, raised hand, and ramrod. The SE ram cap ROI starts X307 to exclude the hand/rod pixels to its left.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Median of four fresh cap-top to individual supporting-sole spans, rounded to nearest native pixel with half upward; one source-wide scale across all actions, no per-cell or per-phase rescaling.
measurementContract.firingMouthMethod: Fresh close native crop and dark opening inspection distinguished from bayonet tip; alpha64 dark-pixel mask supports the mouth region but does not reconstruct a physical bore center.

nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: Targeted red/yellow pixels are absent at alpha64; near-transparent residue remains untouched. This is not exhaustive alpha/fringe certification.

Concealed pelvis center, small fingers, cheek/stock and shoulder attachment remain estimated from 2D overlap; physical anatomy and supporting-foot depth are not certified.
Cap-to-individual-sole spans are [371, 353, 384, 370] native pixels; one source reference height 371 preserves their 31-pixel variation and lower firing head as source posture.
Native SE/SW front diagonal interpretation is accepted by head, chest, feet and rifle bearing; exact camera calibration and a canonical 45-degree ballistic axis are not established.
Near-transparent red/yellow RGB residue persists below alpha64; targeted solid-padding and color tests do not prove exhaustive fringe removal or perfect transparency.
Model-assisted independent inspection; human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production and complete-family certification remain false.
Final renderer continuity, pauses/checkpoints, decoded/GPU/process residency, device performance and human usability remain separate checks.
